# Maestra

> Maestra is an AI-powered media localization platform offering transcription, translation, dubbing, and subtitle generation in 125+ languages.

Maestra provides both free web-based tools and enterprise solutions for converting and localizing audio and video content. The platform supports real-time transcription, AI voice cloning, and multilingual subtitle generation with 99% accuracy across multiple file formats and integrations.

## Key Topics

- AI Transcription
- Multilingual Support (125+ languages)
- Real-time Transcription
- Video Translation
- Subtitle Generation
- AI Dubbing
- Voice Cloning
- Audio-to-Text
- Speech Recognition
- API Integration
- Enterprise Solutions
- Voiceover Generation
- Meeting Transcription
- Podcast Transcription

## Core Platform

- [Maestra - AI Media Translation, Subtitles & Dubbing Platform](https://maestra.ai): Maestra AI platform for transcripts, subtitles, dubbing in 125+ languages
- [Tools](https://maestra.ai/tools): Maestra's collection of AI transcription, translation, and dubbing tools
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://maestra.ai/enterprise): Enterprise AI solutions with API, SSO, and real-time support from Maestra

## Transcription & Speech-to-Text

- [Audio to Text Converter](https://maestra.ai/tools/audio-to-text): Free AI audio-to-text converter supporting 125+ languages in real-time
- [Video to Text Transcription](https://maestra.ai/tools/video-to-text): Free AI video-to-text transcription tool supporting 125+ languages
- [MP3 to Text Converter](https://maestra.ai/tools/audio-to-text/convert-mp3-to-text): Free MP3-to-text AI transcription converter supporting 125+ languages
- [Interview Transcription Software](https://maestra.ai/tools/interview-transcription-software): AI interview transcription software for 125+ languages with accuracy
- [Podcast Transcription Service](https://maestra.ai/tools/podcast-transcription-service): Fast AI podcast transcript generator supporting 125+ languages
- [Meeting Transcription](https://maestra.ai/tools/meeting-transcription): Free live and on-demand meeting transcription with real-time translation
- [Voice Memos to Text](https://maestra.ai/tools/audio-to-text/voice-memos-to-text): Cloud-based voice memo transcription with AI speech recognition

## Translation & Localization

- [Video Translator](https://maestra.ai/tools/video-translator): AI video translator for instant localization to 125+ languages
- [Audio Translator](https://maestra.ai/tools/audio-translator): Free AI audio translation tool for instant voice translation

## Subtitles & Dubbing

- [Subtitle Generator](https://maestra.ai/tools/subtitle-generator): 99% accurate AI subtitle generator for 125+ languages with styling
- [Video Dubber](https://maestra.ai/tools/video-dubber): AI video dubbing and voice cloning tool for 125+ languages

## Language-Specific Transcription

- [Spanish Speech to Text](https://maestra.ai/tools/audio-to-text/transcribe-spanish): Spanish speech-to-text transcription with real-time and on-demand options
- [French Speech to Text](https://maestra.ai/tools/audio-to-text/transcribe-french): French speech-to-text transcription with real-time and free options
- [Arabic Speech to Text](https://maestra.ai/tools/audio-to-text/transcribe-arabic): Arabic speech-to-text transcription with real-time translation capability
- [Portuguese Speech to Text](https://maestra.ai/tools/audio-to-text/transcribe-portuguese): Portuguese speech-to-text transcription with real-time and free options
